lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance pixel clusters are arranged in a multi-columnar grid posterior to the pectoral fin. Primary columns contain 4-5 spots with uniform spacing, forming a repetitive geometric matrix across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with columns of spots, creating a lattice where spots serve as anchor nodes at the intersection of horizontal rows and vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the most prominent exhibits a sharp intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small teleost fish (remoras) are visible in the ventral region below the pectoral fin and main body trunk.
